verdict.rationale: GitHub publishes an official GitHub MCP server (github/github-mcp-server). First-party docs show it gives agents access to repositories, issues, pull requests and other GitHub features, and that it can be configured either remotely or locally. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the server in use, explicit documentation of connecting non-Copilot third-party agents (the docs mainly frame it around Copilot Chat in the IDE).
